subject: Order form / MSA: pen-test timing, scope carveouts, and evidence delivery proposal
messages:
From: Maria Santos <maria.santos@arcadiahealth.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Arcadia Health Legal <contracts@arcadiahealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T09:15:00-04:00
Subject: MSA / Order Form - pen test window & evidence transfer questions

Hi Mateo —

Thanks again for the draft MSA and order form. Our security team reviewed the audit rights and pen-test language and flagged a few items we need tightened before legal can sign:

1) Production pen tests: Arcadia requires that vendor-initiated or customer-contracted pen tests run only against non-production copies (staging or pre-prod) unless explicit risk review is completed. We need the order form to restrict destructive testing on prod.

2) Notification & deconfliction: 72 hours minimum notice plus a point-of-contact to schedule a maintenance window.

3) Evidence delivery: when SOC 2 artifacts or pen-test reports are requested, we prefer delivery to a secure SFTP or an encrypted link with MFA. Weekly email dumps of logs are not acceptable for our auditors.

4) Scope clarity: tests should be scoped to the customer tenant, and any shared infra must be excluded or require a Redwood-signed attestation of no-impact.

Can you propose redline language that preserves your audit rights but addresses the above? Attaching Arcadia's standard clause for reference.

-Maria
Maria Santos
Security Program Manager, Arcadia Health
security@arcadiahealth.com

Subject: Re: MSA / Order Form - pen test window & evidence transfer questions

Hi Maria —

Appreciate the clear ask and the sample clause. We want to keep a practical audit path for customers while minimizing blast radius and operational disruption. Below is a short proposal for negotiation — Karthish and Jonas are on legal review and I copied Marissa to keep the commercial side aligned.

Proposal highlights:
- Production carveout: Redwood will accept a default prohibition on active intrusive pen tests against production tenant resources unless the customer signs a scoped production-pen exception addendum. This addendum requires a joint risk review, agreed test plan, and a minimum 14-day booking window.
- Deconfliction: Redwood requires 72 hours advanced notice for tests that touch platform components; for scheduled, non-intrusive scans we can accept 48 hours. A named engineering POC is required.
- Evidence delivery: We will deliver SOC 2 report excerpts and pen-test summaries via an encrypted S3 pre-signed link (MFA enforced) or secure SFTP. Full raw logs that contain other customers' metadata will not be shared; instead we will provide sanitized exports and a signed attestation describing the exported artifacts.
- Scope definition: Tests must be scoped to the customer's workload identifiers (tenant id / project id). Shared infra or hypervisor-level testing is excluded. If Arcadia requests a scoped production test, the production exception addendum applies.

I've attached a short draft of the redline language and a proposed one-page production-exception addendum for your review. We're aiming for language that legal can sign off on without lengthy back-and-forth.

Next steps: Karthish (legal) to confirm final legal wording; Marissa to confirm order-form flow and whether we need to add billing or SLA carveouts for any downtime windows.

Best,
Mateo
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Date: 2026-11-02T10:22:00-05:00
Subject: Re: MSA / Order Form - pen test window & evidence transfer questions

Thanks Mateo —

Couple of follow-ups from our side after reviewing your proposal:

* The 14-day booking window for production exceptions is OK, but we need a guaranteed response SLA from Redwood (48 hours) to accept or deny the exception once we submit the joint plan.
* For evidence delivery — an S3 pre-signed link is acceptable only if it's time-limited and Arcadia's auditors can authenticate via our SSO. Can Redwood support SSO-auth gated downloads?
* We want the attestation to include the hash of any artifacts provided and the exact queries used to generate log exports for audit reproducibility.

Minor ask: can you confirm whether Redwood would be able to provide an isolated 'scoped staging environment' for Arcadia that mirrors prod for pen tests at an additional runbook cost? If yes, what are the lead times and cost estimate?

Maria — can we get engineering availability for a short call tomorrow to talk about an implementation plan?

-Arcadia Legal

Hi —

Thanks — quick answers below and then legal can decide on formal language: 

- 48-hour SLA to accept/deny production exception: Redwood can commit to a 48-hour business-hours response from the security and infra on receipt of a complete exception request (complete means joint test plan + risk checklist). We'll put that into the production-exception addendum as a defined timeframe.
- SSO-gated downloads: Redwood supports SAML-based SSO for secure artifact delivery (we can provision a read-only role scoped to the Arcadia account; downloads are time-limited links and we can add IP restrictions). We'll note the requirement for SSO-auth in the evidence delivery clause.
- Artifact hashing & reproducibility: We can include a signed attestation with SHA-256 hash of exported archives plus the exact query parameters used to extract logs (where applicable). For multi-tenant artifacts we will sanitize PII and exclude other customers' metadata.
- Scoped staging: We can provide a customer-dedicated staging sandbox on dedicated capacity; typical lead time 3-4 weeks and we would propose a fixed runbook fee (TBD, Marissa to confirm).

If Arcadia is comfortable with those operational controls, Karthish and Jonas will produce precise redline wording. Maria — happy to take the call; engineering can join Wednesday 11/3 10:00 PT.

Best,
Mateo

Mateo —

Thanks, this is helpful and close to what we need. Confirming:
- We accept the production-exception workflow with a 48-hour response SLA, provided the addendum includes a final clause that Redwood will not perform live exploitative testing against shared backend services.
- SSO-gated, time-limited links + SHA-256 attestation suffice for our auditors. Please include sample attestation text in the redline.
- For scoped staging: Arcadia would like a ballpark cost to include in procurement planning. Marissa — can you send a one-page estimate and lead-time sheet after the call?

We can do the engineering call 11/3 10:00 PT — Maria, Arcadia will have our security architect on the line. Please send the calendar invite and the final redline after the call.

-Maria
